description:
## Goal

src/fetcher/gc_collector.cr only triggers GC if
Supervisor.run_timed_refresh completes a cycle. If the refresh
cycle is skipped (memory pressure) or runs > 30 min, no GC
happens for that entire window. On FreeBSD, Boehm GC fragmentation
can let RSS climb even when no real leak exists.

This task is the implementation of the existing design ticket
quickhea-hwp.

## Approach

1. In MemoryManagerActor (src/services/memory_manager_actor.cr),
   add a periodic timer fiber that wakes every 30 min and:
     a. Calls GC.collect twice
     b. Calls LibGC.GC_gcollect_and_unmap once
     c. Logs before/after RSS + heap_size + unmapped_bytes
2. Make the interval configurable via a constant or actor
   message (default 30 min, easy to override for tests).
3. Skip the forced GC if a refresh cycle is in progress
   (refreshing? == true) to avoid clashing with the cycle's
   own GC. On the next tick, run as normal.
4. Wire it up in the same place where Monitoring.start is
   called (refresh_loop.cr:start).

## Acceptance

- Forced GC runs every 30 min even when refresh is skipped.
- Before/after heap stats are logged with a recognizable
  message.
- The new code does not deadlock on FreeBSD (use :unchecked
  mutex pattern as documented in AGENTS.md).
- Build + spec + ameba clean.
- Closes quickhea-hwp on completion.
title: Implement quickhea-hwp: periodic forced full GC backstop
